text:
lucy: quick heads-up: two customers reported sudden 429 cascades from the edge when backend quota reconciler lagged. UX hit is pretty bad. we should land a standard for graceful degradation at ingress (not just a local 429).

ben: yep saw the traces. pattern was: ingress asks local quota -> controller responds DENIED because global commit not yet applied -> ingress emits hard 429. what are people thinking — queue, partial reply, or retry-hint?

lucy: leaning towards a multi-mode approach: 1) brief borrow from a small local ephemeral credit pool; 2) if borrow not allowed, return a structured soft-deny with retry/backoff hint; 3) for streaming endpoints, hold the connection and stream a progress token (instead of terminating).

diego: ephemeral credit pool makes sense. tradeoffs: increases complexity for sync between ingress and quota service. need safety: cap borrow to Y tokens per tenant per minute and require reconciliation accounting to avoid long-term drift.

meera: and don't forget fairness: if many tenants borrow concurrently, we need a scheduler that preserves weight-based fairness and prevents hot tenants from monopolizing ephemeral credits. propose using token-bucket per-tenant + global shared reserve with borrowing rules.

ben: agreed. sketch of borrow rules: 
- each tenant has local_bucket (refill X/s)
- global_reserve for the edge (refill G/s)
- when request denied by controller, edge attempts borrow = min(request_cost, borrow_limit_per_request)
- borrowing increments tenant_debt metric and is reconciled asynchronously
- if tenant_debt > debt_threshold -> reduce borrow window and emit probation tag

lucy: also want clear signals in the response for observability and for client SDKs. e.g., headers: X-Redwood-Edge-Action: borrow|soft-deny|hard-deny and X-Redwood-Retry-After: 150ms;backoff=exp. we will update SDKs to honor these by default.

meera: abuse surface: attackers can hammer partial/borrow flows to amplify requests at lower cost. mitigation: require per-tenant borrow budget, link borrow eligibility to recent success ratio, and throttle retries with increasing penalty. also add a heuristic score that grows on excessive retries.

diego: we must define telemetry fields in the trace span so SRE can run retros. propose span tags: edge.mode, borrow_amount, quota_controller_rtt, tenant_debt, fairness_weight, policy_rev. these are already fairly standard but make them required for the feature.

ben: compatibility: private deployments may forbid borrowing or partials for compliance. flag in config: edge.allow_ephemeral_borrow (global default true) and per-tenant override deny. update admission proto to include BorrowHint { allowed: bool, max_tokens: int, mode: BORROW|STREAM|PARTIAL } and make it additive.

lucy: rollout plan: small canary in one region behind a feature flag for 2 days, synthetic load that simulates a conversation flow (multistep calls). monitor session-level dropout, p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, and fraction_borrowed. abort if session dropout up > 1% or cost/unit > +10%.

meera: experiments: we should run a controlled test with two client behaviors: polite SDK that respects retry hints (with exp backoff) and aggressive client that retries immediately. metrics: error-rate per client-type, total tokens consumed, avg latency, tenant_debt growth. want to ensure polite clients benefit and aggressive clients get penalized.

ben: edge scheduling note: when multiple tenants compete and global reserve is low, use deficit-round-robin weighted by tenant_priority_score. don't starve low-volume tenants; keep min-guarantee per tenant for critical customers.

diego: implementation detail: reconcile tenant_debt by sending periodic debit events to quota-controller. ensure idempotency and tie to request IDs. on mismatch, trigger a follow-up audit job so we can surface any accounting drift.

lucy: security checklist: 1) cap total borrow allowance per deployment to avoid stealth DOS, 2) require signed retry hints for private deployments to avoid header spoofing, 3) log borrow grant events to an immutable audit log for compliance.

opsbot: ops-bot: feature-flag created: edge_ephemeral_borrow_v1, canary windows set for us-east-1 and eu-west-1, rollout pipeline ready.

meera: docs + SDKs: update the SDK retry behavior to default to honoring X-Redwood-Retry-After with exp backoff and a max of 1s. also document new headers and per-route capability flags in Console.

ben: action items: 
- ben: proto patch for BorrowHint and admission-side flags (PR by Thu)
- diego: implement borrow accounting + reconcile flow (prototype by next Tue)
- meera: abuse heuristics and penalty escalation design (doc by Mon)
- lucy: canary plan + synthetic workloads + dashboards (by Wed)

lucy: any objections? if not, i'll open a short RFC follow-up and attach proto diff + dashboard templates.

meera: no objections. sounds sensible.

opsbot: ops-bot: RFC created: rfc/edge-ephemeral-borrow-5098765432.md

ben: starting PR now.

diego: will sync with quota-controller team on reconciliation semantics.

lucy: thanks everyone. we'll iterate after the canary results.
